newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cycle & Carriage sells stake in associate.
newsitem.headline: Cycle & Carriage sells stake in associate.

text.p: Cycle & Carriage (CCL) said on Wednesday it sold its stake in Robert Bosch (South East Asia) Pte Ltd for Singapore $18 million.
It said in a statement it disposed its 30 percent interest in the automotive and household appliances company, comprising 2.4 million ordinary shares of S$1.00 each, on January 31.
The shares were sold to Robert Bosch Internationale Beteiligungen AG, which already held the other 70 percent, to enable it to consolidate interest in its subsidiary.
The amount of S$18 million took into account the underlying net tangible asset value of the shares.
Robert Bosch (South East Asia) will now cease to be an associated company of CCL, the statement said.
The sale is not expected to have any significant effect on the earnings per share or net tangible assets per share of CCL for the current financial year ending December 31, 1997.
